# vendor/

Look code from [mromidev/claude-animated-shorts](https://github.com/mromidev/claude-animated-shorts) (MIT, see LICENSE),
converted from TypeScript with esbuild:

- `toon.js`: the flat 2D cartoon character drawer (bean heads, faces, bodies, hats). Local addition: `hairCut`.
- `paint.js`: painted HD textures (facades, roofs, cobbles, stone, grass).
- `shade.js`, `cardshade.js`, `lights.js`: two-tone world lighting, lit character cards, day and golden presets.
- `ink.js`: the world ink-outline pass, ported from the `postprocessing` library to three's EffectComposer.

Only the code is used. Story, characters (Max) and voice are our own.
